title: GPT-3.5 series
before: GPT-3 was the deployed base model, with InstructGPT as a research result.
problem: The research recipe had to become a maintained product line.
breakthrough: A family of instruction-tuned GPT-3 descendants, including the code-trained variants, serving the API and ChatGPT.
why: The model behind ChatGPT's launch, and the one whose outputs trained Alpaca and much of the early open ecosystem.
next: GPT-4 replaced it at the frontier; distillation from it seeded open instruction models.
inherits: The production instruction-tuned model as a distinct artefact from the base model.
